effects.demerger: Price drops by roughly the value of the business moved to the new company; holders get shares of that company.
effects.split: Price is divided by the split ratio; you hold proportionally more shares. No change in value.
effects.consolidation: Opposite of a split: price is multiplied, you hold fewer shares. No change in value.
effects.bonus: Free extra shares; price adjusts down in proportion. No change in value.
effects.rights: New shares offered at a set price; the market price adjusts slightly if that price is below market.
effects.capital reduction: Share count and price change under a court-approved scheme; check the terms.
effects.restructuring: Merger or scheme of arrangement; price and holdings can change, check the scheme terms.
